Pending new owner address, staged by transferOwnership and promoted by acceptOwnership.
_totalSupply token supply of BioCoin, initialized to 10000000 in the constructor.
Mapping of address to token balance used by transfer/transferFrom and read by balanceOf.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to allowance, written by approve and transferFrom.
Token symbol string, set to CoP in the constructor.
Token name string, set to BioCoin in the constructor.
Token decimals value, set to 0 in the constructor.
SafeMath.safeAdd: performs a + b and requires c >= a to guard against overflow.
SafeMath.safeSub: requires b <= a then computes a - b to guard against underflow.
SafeMath.safeMul: multiplies and checks a == 0 || c / a == b against overflow.
SafeMath.safeDiv: requires b > 0 before dividing a / b.
Owned constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender.
Ownership transfer entry point guarded by the onlyOwner modifier; stages newOwner.
Accepts ownership; requires msg.sender == newOwner, then promotes newOwner to owner and resets newOwner to address(0).
BioCoin constructor: initializes symbol, name, decimals, supply and pre-allocates all tokens to a fixed address.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Returns balances[tokenOwner].
Transfers tokens: subtracts from balances[msg.sender] via safeSub and adds to balances[to] via safeAdd.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Spends allowance: subtracts from balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], adds to balances[to].
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then performs an external call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval, creating a reentrancy surface.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts.
Owner-only function that performs an external ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) call.
msg.sender, attacker-controllable caller identity used for authorization, balances and allowances.
Unsigned integer subtraction on balances/allowances relying on SafeMath.safeSub; arithmetic overflow/underflow class operation.
Unsigned integer addition on balances relying on SafeMath.safeAdd; arithmetic overflow class operation.
External call to an arbitrary spender contract receiveApproval after state mutation, allowing reentrancy.
External call to an arbitrary token contract from the owner-only function, allowing reentrancy.

edges.reason: msg.sender supplies the sender balance key modified by transfer.
msg.sender supplies the allowance owner key written by approve.
msg.sender indexes allowed[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom, so the caller identity controls allowance spending.
msg.sender is written into the allowance mapping before the external receiveApproval call in approveAndCall.
msg.sender is compared against owner by the onlyOwner modifier guarding transferAnyERC20Token.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner, making caller identity the authorization check.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
The Owned constructor assigns ownership to msg.sender.
The to parameter supplies the destination key for the safeAdd balance update.
The tokens parameter is the operand used in the safeSub and safeAdd balance arithmetic.
The spender parameter supplies the allowance mapping key in approve.
The from parameter supplies the balance key subtracted from with safeSub in transferFrom.
The attacker-controlled data parameter is forwarded into the external receiveApproval call.
The tokenAddress parameter determines which external contract is invoked in transferAnyERC20Token.
safeAdd parameter a is an operand of the checked addition.
safeAdd parameter b is an operand of the checked addition.
Local c receives a + b in safeAdd and is validated by require(c >= a).
The Owned constructor sets the owner state variable from msg.sender, establishing authorization state.
transferOwnership stages newOwner, which is the pathway to reassigning the owner variable.
acceptOwnership writes the owner state variable, completing the privilege handover.
transfer executes safeSub on balances[msg.sender], invoking the arithmetic operation.
transfer executes safeAdd on balances[to], invoking the arithmetic operation.
approve writes the allowed mapping state variable.
transferFrom executes safeSub on balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom executes safeAdd on balances[to].
approveAndCall performs the external receiveApproval call after mutating the allowance mapping.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external ERC20 transfer call to an owner-supplied address.
The receiveApproval external call can re-enter approveAndCall or other BioCoin entry points before the call returns.
The external ERC20 transfer call can re-enter transferAnyERC20Token and the owner-only surface.
The receiveApproval callback can re-enter transfer using the allowance set earlier in approveAndCall.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter to is only used as the destination key inside transfer, so it is normalized into that function node.
Parameter tokens is consumed solely by the arithmetic inside transfer and merges into it.
Parameter spender is used only as a mapping key in approve and normalizes into that function.
Parameter from is used only as a balance key in transferFrom and normalizes into that function.
Parameter data is only forwarded in the external call made by approveAndCall.
Parameter tokenAddress only selects the external callee inside transferAnyERC20Token.
Parameter a is a pure operand of the SafeMath.safeAdd addition.
Parameter b is a pure operand of the SafeMath.safeAdd addition.
Local variable c is the result slot of safeAdd and has no independent semantic identity.
